name: sem_queue
description: A 'custom queue' implemented ENTIRELY in a plugin (doc 24): N-way admission via a process-global counting semaphore, with zero core buffering — the plugin's semaphore is the sole admission control ('depth 0' custody) while the ordered output comes for free from the core's per-lane emit gate. ONE DLL, TWO ROLES sharing the semaphore via statics: role 'source' owns a deep std::deque backlog and a dedicated producer thread that acquire()s a permit then emit()s one item into the dispatch lane (at most N ever in flight); the ack role's xi.pack@1 door release()s one permit on completion, driven inline by the inspect's use('sem_ack').process() as its last step. get_def surfaces the shared 'inflight'/'max_inflight' instrumentation so a driver can assert max in-flight == N.
